info.title: Infrastructure Intelligence OTLP Receiver API
info.description: Isolated OTLP/HTTP Protobuf intake for allowlisted metrics, logs, and metadata-only generative-AI usage spans. The production profile requires both a CA-verified SPIFFE client certificate and a tenant-bound channel Bearer credential. This listener exposes no Infrastructure Intelligence control-plane operations.

200.description: Receiver and required durable dependencies are ready

503.description: The database or required schema migration is unavailable

post.description: Accept one bounded OTLP metrics export under a protected tenant-bound channel.
Accept one bounded OTLP logs export under a protected tenant-bound channel.

Accept one bounded OTLP trace export, normalize only approved generative-AI invocation metadata, and durably commit usage plus its event before success. Prompt, response, message, tool, embedding, retrieval-document, span-event, span-link, and raw payload content is prohibited.

otlpChannelBearerAuth.description: Independent receiver credential. Protected configuration fixes tenant, integration, resource/service/model scope, signal catalogs, commercial dimensions, limits, sensitivity, and retention.

otlpMutualTLS.description: Customer-CA-verified client certificate containing exactly one protected-registry SPIFFE URI SAN bound to the selected channel. Required by the production profile.

OtlpInvalidRequest.description: The OTLP protobuf or normalized signal semantics are invalid

OtlpUnauthorized.description: The receiver channel credential is missing or invalid

OtlpPolicyDenied.description: Evidence collection policy denied the configured channel scope

OtlpReceiverDisabled.description: This signal is disabled on the receiver

OtlpRequestTooLarge.description: The encoded, decompressed, or normalized payload exceeded a channel bound

OtlpUsageConflict.description: The same tenant/channel/span identity was previously committed with different usage metadata

OtlpUnsupportedMedia.description: Only OTLP binary Protobuf with identity or gzip content encoding is accepted

OtlpRateLimited.description: The authenticated channel exceeded its process-level request admission budget

OtlpUnavailable.description: The evidence processor, policy, or durable storage boundary is unavailable
